description: Use this when the user asks to delete a specific memory, given the id returned by search. Ask the user to confirm before calling it: the deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. Do not use it to fix a memory that is merely out of date: saving the corrected version with cortex_write is what keeps the history.

id.description: The id of the memory to delete, exactly as returned by search

name: cortex_forget
title: Forget memory
